## companies

**🏢 Companies (ZEFIX + SOGC).** Search the Swiss commercial register, company details by UID, gazette publications.

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `search_companies` | Search the Swiss commercial register (ZEFIX, 700k+ entities) by company name. |
| `get_company` | Full ZEFIX record for one company: purpose, translations, seat, status, legal form, SOGC date and register links. |
| `list_legal_forms` | List the legal-form codes (ZEFIX legalFormId) used in the Swiss commercial register (AG, GmbH, foundation, …). |
| `list_cantons` | All 26 Swiss cantons with their two-letter abbreviations (used as filters across Swissyphus tools). |
| `search_sogc_publications` | Search official Swiss Official Gazette of Commerce (SOGC/SHAB) publications: commercial-register mutations (HR), bankruptcies (KK), debt enforcement, and more. |

Sources:

- [ZEFIX — Central Business Name Index](https://www.zefix.admin.ch) (Federal Office of Justice (FOJ) / Federal Commercial Registry Office). Licence: Public register data, free consultation; attribution required.
- [SOGC/SHAB — Swiss Official Gazette of Commerce](https://amtsblattportal.ch) (SECO (Swiss Official Gazette of Commerce)). Licence: Official publications, public; attribution required.

## transport

**🚆 Public transport.** Timetable connections, departure/arrival boards, station search — live SBB data.

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `get_connections` | Find the next train/bus/tram/boat connections between two Swiss stations or addresses, with platforms, delays, transfers and per-leg details. |
| `get_departures` | Live departure board for a Swiss public transport station, with delays and platforms. |
| `get_arrivals` | Live arrival board for a Swiss public transport station. |
| `search_stations` | Search Swiss public transport stations and stops by name. |
| `get_nearby_stations` | Find public transport stations near a WGS84 point, sorted by distance. |

Sources:

- [Swiss public transport API (transport.opendata.ch)](https://transport.opendata.ch) (Opendata.ch (data: SBB / opentransportdata.swiss)). Licence: Open use, fair-use rate limits (1000 req/day guideline).

## weather

**🌦️ Weather (MeteoSwiss).** Current conditions, 8-day forecast, official warnings, live station measurements.

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `get_weather` | MeteoSwiss current conditions, 8-day forecast and active weather warnings for a Swiss postal code (via the MeteoSwiss app service). |
| `get_weather_warnings` | Active MeteoSwiss weather warnings (wind, thunderstorms, heat, snow, flood, forest fire…) for a Swiss postal code, with danger levels 1–5 (via the MeteoSwiss app service). |
| `get_current_measurements` | Live 10-minute measurements from the official MeteoSwiss (SwissMetNet) station network. |
| `get_weather_history` | Historical measurements from an official SwissMetNet station over a date range (recent weeks), delivered via the api.existenz.ch proxy. |
| `get_pollen` | Live hourly pollen concentrations from the official MeteoSwiss pollen monitoring network. |
| `list_weather_stations` | List official SwissMetNet stations reporting a given parameter, with coordinates and altitude. |

Sources:

- [MeteoSwiss app service (local forecast & warnings)](https://www.meteoswiss.admin.ch) (MeteoSwiss). Licence: Not an OGD dataset: undocumented MeteoSwiss app back-end (app-prod-ws.meteoswiss-app.ch) with no published terms of use; data © MeteoSwiss. Migration to MeteoSwiss OGD local forecasts on data.geo.admin.ch is planned..
- [MeteoSwiss — Federal Office of Meteorology and Climatology (OGD)](https://www.meteoswiss.admin.ch) (MeteoSwiss). Licence: Swiss OGD — free use with attribution.
- [SwissMetNet station history via api.existenz.ch](https://api.existenz.ch) (MeteoSwiss (data); api.existenz.ch (third-party proxy, not affiliated with MeteoSwiss)). Licence: Underlying data: MeteoSwiss OGD — free use with attribution. Delivery: api.existenz.ch, a free third-party service (fair use; see its terms)..

## hydrology

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `get_water_data` | Latest water level, discharge and temperature for a FOEN hydrology station, by numeric station ID. |
| `get_water_history` | Historical water level, discharge or temperature for a FOEN station over a date range (recent weeks). |
| `list_hydro_stations` | List FOEN river/lake monitoring stations with their IDs and water bodies. |

Sources:

- [FOEN Hydrology — river & lake levels, discharge, temperature (via api.existenz.ch)](https://www.hydrodaten.admin.ch) (Federal Office for the Environment (FOEN/BAFU); delivered by api.existenz.ch (third-party proxy)). Licence: Underlying data: FOEN hydrological data terms — free use with attribution. Delivery: api.existenz.ch, a free third-party service not affiliated with FOEN (fair use; see its terms)..

## geo

**🗺️ Geodata (swisstopo).** Geocoding, elevation, municipalities, solar potential, map-layer identify.

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `geocode` | Search Swiss addresses, places, municipalities and postal codes and return coordinates (WGS84 + LV95). |
| `reverse_geocode` | Find the nearest registered building/address for WGS84 coordinates using the federal Register of Buildings and Dwellings (GWR). |
| `get_elevation` | Return the terrain elevation in metres above sea level for WGS84 coordinates in Switzerland. |
| `get_elevation_profile` | Compute a terrain elevation profile along a line of WGS84 points (e.g. |
| `get_municipality` | Return the Swiss municipality (Gemeinde) containing the given WGS84 point, including its official BFS number and canton. |
| `get_solar_potential` | Return the federal Sonnendach solar-energy suitability of the roof surface(s) within 5 m of the given WGS84 coordinates, nearest first: suitability class, mean irradiation per m² (kWh/m²/yr), total roof-surface irradiation (kWh/yr), roof area, orientation and slope. |
| `identify_map_layers` | Power tool: query any federal geodata layer(s) at a WGS84 point (e.g. |

Sources:

- [swisstopo geo.admin.ch API](https://api3.geo.admin.ch) (Federal Office of Topography swisstopo). Licence: Free use with source attribution (geo.admin.ch terms of use).

## coords

**📐 Coordinate conversion.** LV95 (EPSG:2056) ↔ WGS84, with LV03 legacy output — computed locally, instant.

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `convert_wgs84_to_lv95` | Convert WGS84 latitude/longitude (Switzerland and surroundings) to Swiss LV95 coordinates (EPSG:2056). |
| `convert_lv95_to_wgs84` | Convert Swiss LV95 coordinates (EPSG:2056, easting ~2'600'000 / northing ~1'200'000) to WGS84 latitude/longitude. |

Sources:

- [swisstopo reference frame conversion formulas](https://www.swisstopo.admin.ch/en/coordinates-conversion-navref) (Federal Office of Topography swisstopo). Licence: Public formulas, free use.

| Tool | What it does |

| `list_recent_legislation_changes` | What changed in Swiss federal law in a date range (Classified Compilation): 'amended' = acts for which a new consolidated version became applicable (amendments taking effect, incl. |

## statistics

**📊 Statistics & open data.** Search 12'000+ Swiss OGD datasets (opendata.swiss + City of Zürich) and query their actual data: filter, profile and aggregate CSV/JSON/GeoJSON resources.

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `get_population` | Official permanent resident population (BFS STATPOP) for Switzerland and every canton, latest available year. |
| `search_datasets` | Full-text search over the national open-data catalogue opendata.swiss (default) or the City of Zürich portal (portal='stadt-zuerich'): statistics (population, prices, energy…), geodata, transport, health and more. |
| `get_dataset` | Full metadata for one dataset on opendata.swiss (or portal='stadt-zuerich'): description, publisher, licence and every resource with its 0-based index, format, whether it is queryable by query_dataset, and its direct download link. |
| `query_dataset` | Fetch the actual data of an opendata.swiss / City of Zürich dataset and return matching rows. |
| `describe_dataset_columns` | Fetch and parse a dataset's best CSV/JSON/GeoJSON resource (or a direct resource_url) and return its row count and, per column, the detected type (number/string/mixed), non-null count and example values — use it to plan query_dataset filters or aggregate_dataset group-bys. |
| `aggregate_dataset` | Group a dataset's rows by one or two columns and compute count, sum, avg, min or max of a numeric column (after optional where/search filters) — e.g. |
| `list_data_publishers` | List the organisations publishing on opendata.swiss (federal offices, cantons, cities, companies) or on the City of Zürich portal (departments), with their slug and dataset count. |

Sources:

- [opendata.swiss — Swiss OGD catalogue](https://opendata.swiss) (Federal Statistical Office (BFS) / OGD office). Licence: Catalogue metadata: open; each dataset carries its own OGD licence (stated per result).
- [Open Data Stadt Zürich (CKAN catalogue)](https://data.stadt-zuerich.ch) (City of Zürich — Open Government Data office (Statistik Stadt Zürich)). Licence: Per dataset (predominantly CC0 / Creative Commons Zero); stated per result.
- [EnviDat — environmental research data portal (WSL, ETH Domain)](https://www.envidat.ch) (Swiss Federal Institute for Forest, Snow and Landscape Research WSL (with SLF, Eawag, Empa, PSI)). Licence: Per dataset (mostly CC BY 4.0, CC0, ODbL or WSL Data Policy); stated per result.
- [BFS STAT-TAB (PXWeb) — STATPOP population statistics](https://www.pxweb.bfs.admin.ch) (Federal Statistical Office (BFS)). Licence: Swiss OGD — free use with attribution.

## parliament

**🏛️ Parliament (Curia Vista).** Federal parliamentary business, votes, speeches, council members, declared interests, committees and parliamentary groups — official parlament.ch data.

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `search_parliament_business` | Search Curia Vista for federal parliamentary business (motions, postulates, interpellations, bills) by title keyword (case-insensitive). |
| `get_parliament_business` | Details of a specific Curia Vista business by its numeric ID (e.g. |
| `get_session_schedule` | Recent and upcoming sessions of the Federal Assembly with dates and names. |
| `get_parliament_votes` | Formal council votes for a parliamentary business (by short number like '23.4567'), including the subject, what yes/no meant, and the actual yes/no/abstain tallies of the most recent vote. |
| `search_council_members` | Search members of the National Council and Council of States (current by default) by last name (case-insensitive fragment), canton or party abbreviation. |
| `search_parliament_speeches` | Search the verbatim record of speeches in the National Council and Council of States (Amtliches Bulletin transcripts) by speaker and/or keyword, optionally within a date range or session. |
| `get_member_interests` | Lobbying transparency: the declared interests and mandates of a member of the Federal Assembly (board seats, advisory roles, associations, foundations) with the organisation, the member's function, the type of interest and organisation, and paid/unpaid where published — plus declared occupations. |
| `list_parliament_committees` | List committees of the Federal Assembly (legislative committees such as WAK-N/WAK-S economy, SiK security, UREK environment, SGK health, plus supervisory committees GPK/FinK and joint bodies). |
| `get_committee_members` | Current members of one Federal Assembly committee with their function (president, vice-president, member), party, parliamentary group, canton and council. |
| `list_parliamentary_groups` | Current parliamentary groups (Fraktionen: e.g. |

Sources:

- [Curia Vista — parliamentary proceedings database](https://www.parlament.ch) (Parliamentary Services of the Federal Assembly). Licence: Public parliamentary data — free use with attribution.

## airquality

**💨 Air quality (NABEL).** National air-monitoring station directory with links to live data, plus Swiss LRV legal limits (no live values).

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_air_quality_stations` | All stations of the national NABEL air pollution monitoring network with type, altitude, coordinates and a link to each station's live hourly data on the BAFU site (measurement values themselves are not returned). |
| `get_air_quality` | NABEL station details (nearest to a point or by name) together with the Swiss legal ambient limit values (LRV/OAPC) for PM10, PM2.5, NO2, O3, SO2 and CO, plus the link to the station's live hourly measurements. |

Sources:

- [NABEL — National Air Pollution Monitoring Network](https://www.bafu.admin.ch/bafu/en/home/topics/air/state/data.html) (FOEN/BAFU and Empa). Licence: Swiss OGD — free use with attribution.

## energy

**⚡ Energy (ElCom + SFOE).** Official electricity tariffs per municipality with component breakdown; EV charging stations; daily national energy supply (energiedashboard.ch): production by source, consumption, cross-border electricity/gas flows, spot prices, gas storage.

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `get_energy_dashboard` | Daily Swiss energy-supply data from the Federal Office of Energy's energy dashboard: 'electricity_production' (Electricity production by energy source (Swissgrid), GWh/day); 'electricity_consumption' (National and final electricity consumption (Swissgrid), GWh/day); 'electricity_consumption_estimate' (Model-based estimate of national electricity consumption (recent days), GWh/day); 'electricity_consumption_forecast' (Electricity final-consumption forecast min/mean/max (SDSC), GWh/day); 'electricity_cross_border' (Cross-border electricity flows per neighbour and net import, GWh/day); 'electricity_spot_price' (Day-ahead spot price Switzerland, baseload, EUR/MWh); 'gas_cross_border' (Cross-border gas flows per neighbour and net import, GWh/day); 'gas_net_imports_monthly' (Monthly gas net imports (VSG), GWh/month); 'gas_storage_eu' (Gas storage levels EU and neighbouring countries, TWh / % of capacity). |
| `get_electricity_tariff` | Official ElCom electricity tariff for a Swiss municipality, broken into energy, grid usage, community charges and federal grid surcharge (Rp./kWh). |
| `compare_electricity_tariffs` | Compare official electricity tariffs (total Rp./kWh, standard product) across up to 10 Swiss municipalities for one category and year. |
| `get_ev_chargers_nearby` | EV charging stations from the national ich-tanke-strom.ch dataset near WGS84 coordinates: operator, plugs, max power, 24h access, address and number of charge points (evse_count) per station. |

Sources:

- [ElCom electricity tariffs (LINDAS linked data)](https://www.strompreis.elcom.admin.ch) (Federal Electricity Commission ElCom). Licence: Swiss OGD — free use with attribution.
- [ich-tanke-strom.ch — national EV charging infrastructure](https://ich-tanke-strom.ch) (Swiss Federal Office of Energy (SFOE)). Licence: Swiss OGD — free use with attribution.
- [energiedashboard.ch — SFOE energy supply indicators](https://www.energiedashboard.admin.ch) (Swiss Federal Office of Energy (SFOE/BFE); data from Swissgrid, EEX/EPEX, ENTSOG, VSG, SDSC). Licence: opendata.swiss terms per series: 'terms_by' (open use, cite source) for flows, gas, storage and forecasts; 'terms_by_ask' (commercial use needs permission) for electricity production, consumption and spot prices.

| `find_tools` | Keyword search over all Swissyphus tools this server exposes (with the 'discovery' preset: every module, loaded or not). |
| `describe_tool` | Full description and JSON Schema of the arguments of any Swissyphus tool this server exposes, for use with call_tool. |
| `call_tool` | Invoke any Swissyphus tool this server exposes by name — with the 'discovery' preset that includes every module, so the context stays small while the full catalogue is reachable. |
| `list_sources` | The machine-readable register of every data source behind the active Swissyphus modules: operator, licence, attribution string, update frequency, cache TTL and caveats (RFP-grade source governance). |
| `check_source_health` | Ping every upstream Swiss data source behind the active modules and report status and latency — Swissyphus's built-in status page. |
| `about_swissyphus` | Orientation for agents: lists the active modules, what each covers, and example questions each can answer. |

Sources:

- [Swissyphus platform metadata](https://github.com/cwellbournewood/swissyphus) (Swissyphus). Licence: MIT.
